subject: Error: Missing observed variables after recoding

messages.author: d19249c06f283c4b
messages.subject: Error: Missing observed variables after recoding
parts:
Hi all,
I have a problem with lavaan. 
I just tried to do a cfa. But it struggles with my recoded variables. It gives an error that says:
"lavaan ERROR: missing observed variables in dataset"
But when I look in the 'environment' at values, there are data in those items.
Did I do something wrong with recoding? OR is it something in lavaan?

Thanks in advance for helping!

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Error: Missing observed variables after recoding
parts: Please post your syntax to show what you did.

"lavaan ERROR: missing observed variables in dataset"
But when I look in the 'environment' at values, there are data in those items.

This description makes it sound like you stored the recoded variables in new objects, rather than new columns of the data.frame you passed to lavaan's data= argument.
